channel.title: govbot — CPS Board President
channel.description: A single race tracked by govbot; the item updates as candidates are confirmed. The Chicago Board of Education's first voter-elected president. Chicago is moving from a mayor-appointed board to a fully elected 21-member board; the president is elected citywide for the first time on Nov 3, 2026.
